gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-marcellus: Balsamiq Sans draws bold, expressive letters in one unbroken line, no pinched curves. Marcellus serif sits beneath it with the soft, lightly tilted-nib variation of etched glass, refined and literary where the heading is blunt.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-martel: Martel is a classic, editorial serif whose diagonals run a touch thinner than its verticals, as if gently pressed. Under Balsamiq Sans, with its stencil-cut, hairline-free heading, Martel keeps the paragraphs moving with moderate contrast and apertures open like a horseshoe magnet.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-mate-sc: Dignified and classic, Mate SC lets faint nib pressure ripple through round letters, while Balsamiq Sans lays its heading out like spaghetti. Mate SC's brush-lifted curve ends make paragraphs feel steady.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Balsamiq Sans has zero modulation, a bold stencil-cut channel of line with no tight curves anywhere. Nanum Myeongjo, a text serif, adds moderate shading across round and straight strokes, so give it the room to show.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-serif-hk: Balsamiq Sans pours its bold, expressive heading in a stroke that never changes width, with no pinched curves. And Noto Serif HK, a text serif, carries a low-key thick-thin variation and generous curve gaps that keep a long page dignified.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-serif-jp: Noto Serif JP is a literary text serif with an unclenched c and a line that feels steady yet faintly modulated. Noto Serif JP finds a comfortable midpoint between flat and dramatic strokes, which is exactly what Balsamiq Sans, bent-paperclip bold, lacks.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-serif-kr: Thick poured ink, then quiet refinement. Noto Serif KR, a text serif, lets wide s curves and gentle weight shifts in the bowls smooth the reading pace, a soft counterweight to Balsamiq Sans and its single-width stroke.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-serif-sc: Expressive and bold, Balsamiq Sans traces one thick thread through every letter without a pinch. Where it grabs attention, Noto Serif SC, a text serif, settles in with moderate contrast and open, see-through c shapes made for reading.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-serif-tc: Noto Serif TC reads as traditional and refined, with letters held open. Its hairlines stay sturdy beside the stems, so a long passage feels firm, while Balsamiq Sans, with no flared ends, stays bold above it.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-petrona: Petrona reads as dignified and editorial, its modest contrast noticeable only on a close look, with a shallow curl and wide gap at each terminal. Balsamiq Sans, with no calligraphic shading, earns its keep big and short.
